question: L1₂構造を持つ化合物を一覧にして。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    regexp_replace(upper(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
    OR regexp_replace(upper(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    me.number_of_elements,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition AS c
      WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id

      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'

question: 形成エネルギーが負のL1₂型化合物を元素組み合わせごとに整理して。
sql:
SELECT
    x.element_combination,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'entry_id', x.entry_id,
            'formula', x.formula,
            'reduced_formula', x.reduced_formula,
            'formation_energy_per_atom', x.formation_energy_per_atom,
            'space_group_number', x.space_group_number,
            'space_group', x.space_group,
            'prototype', x.prototype,
            'strukturbericht', x.strukturbericht
        )
        ORDER BY x.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, x.reduced_formula
    ) AS l12_compounds
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system AS element_combination,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.space_group,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      )
) x
GROUP BY x.element_combination
ORDER BY x.element_combination
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Alに近い格子定数を持つL1₂化合物を探して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_a_percent_difference
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a)
LIMIT 50;

question: L1₂型化合物の形成エネルギー分布を教えて。
sql:
WITH l12_energies AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          regexp_replace(
              translate(lower(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
              '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) = 'l12'
          OR regexp_replace(
              translate(lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
              '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%l12%'
      )
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        min(formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_fe,
        max(formation_energy_per_atom) AS max_fe
    FROM l12_energies
),
binned AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN b.min_fe = b.max_fe THEN 1
            ELSE least(width_bucket(e.formation_energy_per_atom, b.min_fe, b.max_fe, 20), 20)
        END AS bin_no,
        count(*) AS compound_count
    FROM l12_energies AS e
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    GROUP BY
        CASE
            WHEN b.min_fe = b.max_fe THEN 1
            ELSE least(width_bucket(e.formation_energy_per_atom, b.min_fe, b.max_fe, 20), 20)
        END
)
SELECT
    bin_no,
    CASE
        WHEN b.min_fe = b.max_fe THEN b.min_fe
        ELSE b.min_fe + (bin_no - 1) * (b.max_fe - b.min_fe) / 20.0
    END AS formation_energy_lower_ev_per_atom,
    CASE
        WHEN b.min_fe = b.max_fe THEN b.max_fe
        ELSE b.min_fe + bin_no * (b.max_fe - b.min_fe) / 20.0
    END AS formation_energy_upper_ev_per_atom,
    compound_count
FROM binned
CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
ORDER BY bin_no
LIMIT 10000;

question: Aサイト元素ごとのL1₂型化合物数を集計して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.entry_id,
        s.formula_type,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht
    FROM structure AS s
    WHERE
        regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN ('l12', 'l112')
        OR regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
        OR lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%cu3au%'
        OR lower(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')) IN ('a3b', 'ab3')
),
has_a_site AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.entry_id
    FROM composition AS c
    JOIN l12_entries AS l
        ON l.entry_id = c.entry_id
    WHERE lower(COALESCE(c.site_label, '')) LIKE 'a%'
)
SELECT
    c.element AS a_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM composition AS c
JOIN l12_entries AS l
    ON l.entry_id = c.entry_id
LEFT JOIN has_a_site AS ha
    ON ha.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE
    lower(COALESCE(c.site_label, '')) LIKE 'a%'
    OR (
        ha.entry_id IS NULL
        AND (
            (
                lower(COALESCE(l.formula_type, '')) = 'ab3'
                AND c.atomic_fraction <= 0.34
            )
            OR (
                lower(COALESCE(l.formula_type, '')) = 'a3b'
                AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.66
            )
        )
    )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC, c.element
LIMIT 10000;

sql:
SELECT
    ca.element AS a_site_element,
    cb.element AS b_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS num_l12_compounds,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_per_atom,
    MAX(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_per_atom,
    STDDEV_SAMP(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_per_atom,
    AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable) AS num_stable_compounds,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT me.reduced_formula ORDER BY me.reduced_formula) AS example_formulas
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition ca
    ON ca.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND ca.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
JOIN composition cb
    ON cb.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND cb.site_label ILIKE 'B%'
WHERE
    (
        REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(s.strukturbericht), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'

            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'

            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'

SELECT

    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_a_mismatch_percent,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,

FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s

        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'

question: Aサイト元素別にL1₂型化合物の平均格子定数を集計して。

WITH l12_structures AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.entry_id,
        s.lattice_a
    FROM structure AS s
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          regexp_replace(
              translate(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) = 'L12'
          OR regexp_replace(
              translate(upper(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
          OR regexp_replace(
              translate(upper(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
          OR (
              regexp_replace(
                  translate(upper(COALESCE(s.formula_type, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
                  '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
              ) IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
              AND s.space_group_number = 221
          )
      )
),
a_site_elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.element IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          upper(trim(COALESCE(c.site_label, ''))) IN ('A', 'A_SITE', 'A-SITE', 'A SITE')
          OR upper(trim(COALESCE(c.site_label, ''))) LIKE 'A%'
          OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
          OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 70 AND 80
      )
)
SELECT
    ae.element AS a_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS num_l12_compounds,
    AVG(ls.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_constant
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN l12_structures AS ls
    ON ls.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN a_site_elements AS ae
    ON ae.entry_id = me.entry_id
GROUP BY ae.element
ORDER BY ae.element
LIMIT 10000;

question: 安定なL1₂化合物をAサイト元素でグループ化し、各グループの平均形成エネルギーを出して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom
  FROM material_entry AS me
  JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM structure AS s
      WHERE s.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND (
          s.strukturbericht ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L12%', '%L1_2%', '%L1-2%', '%L1₂%'])
          OR s.prototype ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L12%', '%L1_2%', '%L1-2%', '%L1₂%', '%Cu3Au%'])
          OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND s.formula_type ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%A3B%', '%AB3%'])
          )
        )
    )
  GROUP BY me.entry_id
),
a_site AS (
  SELECT entry_id, element
  FROM (
    SELECT
      c.entry_id,
      c.element,
      c.atomic_fraction,
      CASE
        WHEN UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(c.site_label, '')), '-', '_'), ' ', '_'))
             IN ('A', 'A_SITE', 'ASITE')
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
      END AS is_a_label,
      BOOL_OR(
        UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(c.site_label, '')), '-', '_'), ' ', '_'))
        IN ('A', 'A_SITE', 'ASITE')
      ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS has_a_label,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.entry_id
        ORDER BY c.atomic_fraction DESC NULLS LAST, c.element
      ) AS rn
    FROM composition AS c
    JOIN l12_entries AS le
      ON le.entry_id = c.entry_id
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE is_a_label = TRUE
     OR (has_a_label = FALSE AND rn = 1)
)
SELECT
  a.element AS a_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT le.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count,
  AVG(le.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM l12_entries AS le
JOIN a_site AS a
  ON a.entry_id = le.entry_id
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

question: Al系L1₂化合物のうち安定なものとそうでないものの数を出して。
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable IS TRUE)  AS stable_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable IS FALSE) AS unstable_count
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition AS c
  WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Al'
)
AND (
  s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
)
LIMIT 10000;

question: 準安定L1₂化合物をenergy above hull順にランキングして。
sql:

  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC) AS metastability_rank,
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.space_group,
  s.space_group_number,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0
  AND COALESCE(ps.is_stable, FALSE) = FALSE

  )

question: Bサイト元素ごとの安定L1₂化合物数を集計して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        s.formula_type,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht
    FROM material_entry AS me
    JOIN structure AS s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry AS pde
        ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.number_of_elements = 2
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND s.crystal_system ILIKE '%cubic%'
            )
        )
        AND (
            ps.is_stable = TRUE
            OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
            OR pde.is_on_hull = TRUE
            OR pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
            OR (
                ps.entry_id IS NULL
                AND pde.entry_id IS NULL
            )
        )
),
b_site_composition AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element
    FROM composition AS c
    JOIN l12_entries AS le
        ON le.entry_id = c.entry_id
    WHERE
        c.site_label ILIKE 'B%'
        OR (
            c.site_label IS NULL
            AND (
                (
                    COALESCE(le.formula_type, le.prototype, le.strukturbericht) ILIKE '%AB3%'
                    AND (
                        c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.66 AND 0.80
                        OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 66 AND 80
                        OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 2.5 AND 3.5
                    )
                )
                OR (
                    COALESCE(le.formula_type, le.prototype, le.strukturbericht) NOT ILIKE '%AB3%'
                    AND (
                        c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.34
                        OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 20 AND 34
                        OR c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1.5
                    )
                )
            )
        )
)
SELECT
    bc.element AS b_site_element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bc.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM b_site_composition AS bc
GROUP BY
    bc.element
ORDER BY
    stable_l12_compound_count DESC,
    b_site_element
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物の格子ミスマッチ（Ni3Alとの差）を計算して小さい順に表示して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
          OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      )
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a AS lattice_a,
    ni3al_ref.ni3al_lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    s.lattice_a - ni3al_ref.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_difference,
    ABS((s.lattice_a - ni3al_ref.ni3al_lattice_a) / ni3al_ref.ni3al_lattice_a) * 100.0 AS lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ni3al_ref.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch_percent ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物で安定性と格子定数の両面でNi3Alに近い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.reduced_formula,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        s.lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        )
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),
l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.is_stable,
        ABS(ps.energy_above_hull - r.energy_above_hull) AS delta_energy_above_hull,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - r.lattice_a) AS delta_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
    WHERE
        me.reduced_formula <> 'Ni3Al'
        AND (
            s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
        )
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY delta_energy_above_hull ASC) AS stability_similarity_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY delta_lattice_a ASC) AS lattice_similarity_rank
    FROM l12_candidates
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    crystal_system,
    lattice_a,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    is_stable,
    delta_energy_above_hull,
    delta_lattice_a,
    stability_similarity_rank,
    lattice_similarity_rank,
    stability_similarity_rank + lattice_similarity_rank AS combined_similarity_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
    combined_similarity_rank ASC,
    delta_energy_above_hull ASC,
    delta_lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 25;

question: 遷移金属を含むL1₂型化合物のうち安定なものを出して。
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, pde.is_on_hull, FALSE) AS is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry AS pde
    ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
        ps.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
        OR pde.is_on_hull IS TRUE
        OR pde.hull_distance <= 0.001
      )
  AND (
        lower(
            replace(
                replace(
                    replace(
                        replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'),
                    '_', ''),
                '-', ''),
            ' ', '')
        ) LIKE '%l12%'
        OR lower(
            replace(
                replace(
                    replace(
                        replace(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'),
                    '_', ''),
                '-', ''),
            ' ', '')
        ) LIKE '%l12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
        OR (
            s.space_group_number = 221
            AND (
                s.formula_type ILIKE 'A3B'
                OR s.formula_type ILIKE 'AB3'
                OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
                OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            )
        )
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS c
        LEFT JOIN element AS e
            ON e.symbol = c.element
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND (
                e.block = 'd'
                OR e.group_number BETWEEN 3 AND 12
                OR c.element IN (
                    'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg'
                )
              )
      )
ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST, me.reduced_formula
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型金属間化合物において、相安定性、格子ミスマッチ、弾性特性を同時に考慮した析出強化相候補を抽出して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        p.entry_id,
        p.formula,
        p.reduced_formula,
        sp.prototype,
        sp.strukturbericht,
        sp.space_group_number,
        sp.crystal_system,
        sp.lattice_a,
        sp.formula_type,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable AS phase_is_stable,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        mas.phase
    FROM material_entry p
    JOIN structure sp
        ON sp.entry_id = p.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = p.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = p.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = p.entry_id
    WHERE
        p.number_of_elements >= 2
        AND (
            UPPER(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                    COALESCE(sp.strukturbericht, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(sp.prototype, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(sp.formula_type, ''),
                    '[^A-Za-z0-9]',
                    '',
                    'g'
                )
            ) LIKE '%L12%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE(sp.prototype, '')) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE(sp.prototype, '')) LIKE '%AUCU3%'
            OR (
                sp.space_group_number = 221
                AND UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(sp.formula_type, ''), ' ', '')) IN ('AB3', 'A3B')
            )
        )
),
matrix_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        mas_m.alloy_system_id,
        m.entry_id,
        m.formula,
        sm.lattice_a,
        sm.prototype,
        sm.strukturbericht
    FROM material_alloy_system mas_m
    JOIN material_entry m
        ON m.entry_id = mas_m.entry_id
    JOIN structure sm
        ON sm.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE
        sm.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            mas_m.phase ILIKE '%matrix%'
            OR UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(sm.strukturbericht, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'A1'
            OR sm.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR sm.space_group_number = 225
        )
)
SELECT
    p.entry_id AS precipitate_entry_id,
    p.formula AS precipitate_formula,
    p.reduced_formula AS precipitate_reduced_formula,
    als.system_name AS alloy_system,
    p.phase AS precipitate_phase,
    p.prototype,
    p.strukturbericht,
    p.space_group_number,
    p.crystal_system,
    p.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
    m.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
    m.formula AS matrix_formula,
    m.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a,
    ABS(p.lattice_a - m.lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch,
    p.formation_energy_per_atom,
    p.energy_above_hull,
    p.phase_is_stable,
    p.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    p.shear_modulus_vrh,
    p.youngs_modulus,
    p.poisson_ratio,
    p.elastic_is_stable,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.phase_is_stable, FALSE)
                 OR COALESCE(p.energy_above_hull, 999.0) <= 0.10
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        +
        CASE
            WHEN m.entry_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND p.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                 AND m.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
                 AND ABS(p.lattice_a - m.lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.lattice_a, 0) <= 0.05
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        +
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.elastic_is_stable, FALSE)
                 OR p.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
                 OR p.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS candidate_score
FROM l12_candidates p
LEFT JOIN alloy_system als
    ON als.alloy_system_id = p.alloy_system_id
LEFT JOIN matrix_candidates m
    ON m.alloy_system_id = p.alloy_system_id
    AND m.entry_id <> p.entry_id
WHERE
    p.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        p.phase_is_stable IS NULL
        OR p.phase_is_stable
        OR p.energy_above_hull IS NULL
        OR p.energy_above_hull <= 0.15
    )
    AND (
        m.entry_id IS NULL
        OR ABS(p.lattice_a - m.lattice_a) / NULLIF(m.lattice_a, 0) <= 0.10
    )
ORDER BY
    candidate_score DESC,
    p.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    lattice_mismatch ASC NULLS LAST,
    p.shear_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni₃Al代替またはCo基γ'相候補として有望なL1₂型金属間化合物を、形成エネルギー、格子定数、弾性率の観点から探索して。
γ'相候補のランキングを安定性・格子整合性・バルクモジュラスの重み付きスコアで出して。
NiまたはCo含有で安定かつバルクモジュラスが高いL1₂化合物トップ10を出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS max_bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS c
        WHERE
            c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
    )
GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull
ORDER BY
    max_bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: L1₂型化合物の元素組み合わせと安定性の関係をAサイト・Bサイト別に集計して材料設計の指針を得たい。
sql:
WITH l12_materials AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        MAX(c.element) FILTER (WHERE c.site_label ILIKE 'A%') AS a_site_element,
        MAX(c.element) FILTER (WHERE c.site_label ILIKE 'B%') AS b_site_element
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
)
SELECT
    lm.a_site_element,
    lm.b_site_element,
    COUNT(*) AS num_compounds,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable) AS stable_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        3
    ) AS stable_fraction,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
    AVG(ps.band_gap) AS avg_band_gap,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT lm.formula ORDER BY lm.formula) AS example_formulas
FROM l12_materials lm
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = lm.entry_id
WHERE
    lm.a_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND lm.b_site_element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    lm.a_site_element,
    lm.b_site_element
ORDER BY
    stable_fraction DESC,
    avg_energy_above_hull ASC,
    num_compounds DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Alの格子定数に近く、バルクモジュラスが高く、安定なL1₂候補を総合的にランキングして。
sql:
WITH ni3al_target AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(AVG(s.lattice_a), 3.57) AS target_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
        me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - nt.target_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_abs_diff,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - nt.target_lattice_a) / NULLIF(nt.target_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_a_rel_diff,
        nt.target_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_target nt
    WHERE (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
    AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        1.0 - LEAST(c.lattice_a_rel_diff / 0.05, 1.0) AS lattice_match_score,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY c.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_score,
        CASE
            WHEN c.is_stable THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - LEAST(c.energy_above_hull / 0.10, 1.0)
        END AS stability_score
    FROM candidates c
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            (
                0.40 * lattice_match_score
              + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
              + 0.25 * stability_score
            ) DESC,
            energy_above_hull ASC,
            bulk_modulus_vrh DESC,
            lattice_a_abs_diff ASC
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    crystal_system,
    lattice_a,
    target_lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    lattice_a_abs_diff,
    lattice_a_rel_diff,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    is_stable,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    stability_score,
    (
        0.40 * lattice_match_score
      + 0.35 * bulk_modulus_score
      + 0.25 * stability_score
    ) AS total_score
FROM scored
WHERE stability_score > 0
ORDER BY
    total_score DESC,
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    bulk_modulus_vrh DESC,
    lattice_a_abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 析出強化に適したL1₂化合物を格子ミスマッチ、弾性率、安定性の多基準で評価して上位候補を出して。
sql:
WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.formula_type,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND me.number_of_elements >= 2
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu₃Au%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%A3B%'
            OR s.formula_type ILIKE '%AB3%'
            OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
                AND me.number_of_elements = 2
            )
        )
),
dominant_element AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.entry_id)
        c.entry_id,
        c.element AS matrix_element,
        c.atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    JOIN l12_candidates l12
        ON l12.entry_id = c.entry_id
    ORDER BY c.entry_id, c.atomic_fraction DESC
),
fcc_matrix AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.reduced_formula)
        me.reduced_formula AS matrix_element,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.number_of_elements = 1
        AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.space_group_number = 225
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%A1%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%A1%'
        )
    ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, s.lattice_a
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        l12.entry_id,
        l12.formula,
        l12.reduced_formula,
        l12.chemical_system,
        de.matrix_element,
        l12.prototype,
        l12.strukturbericht,
        l12.precipitate_lattice_a,
        COALESCE(
            fm.matrix_lattice_a,
            2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0
        ) AS matrix_lattice_a,
        100.0
            * ABS(
                l12.precipitate_lattice_a
                - COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0)
            )
            / COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0)
            AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        l12.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        l12.shear_modulus_vrh,
        l12.youngs_modulus,
        l12.formation_energy_per_atom,
        l12.energy_above_hull,
        l12.is_stable,
        (
            0.40 * GREATEST(
                0.0,
                1.0 - LEAST(
                    100.0
                        * ABS(
                            l12.precipitate_lattice_a
                            - COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0)
                        )
                        / COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0),
                    10.0
                ) / 10.0
            )
            + 0.30 * LEAST(
                COALESCE(
                    l12.youngs_modulus,
                    9.0 * l12.bulk_modulus_vrh * l12.shear_modulus_vrh
                        / NULLIF(3.0 * l12.bulk_modulus_vrh + l12.shear_modulus_vrh, 0.0),
                    0.0
                ) / 300.0,
                1.0
            )
            + 0.30 * GREATEST(
                0.0,
                1.0 - LEAST(COALESCE(l12.energy_above_hull, 0.20), 0.20) / 0.20
            )
        ) AS precipitation_strengthening_score
    FROM l12_candidates l12
    JOIN dominant_element de
        ON de.entry_id = l12.entry_id
    JOIN element e
        ON e.symbol = de.matrix_element
    LEFT JOIN fcc_matrix fm
        ON fm.matrix_element = de.matrix_element
    WHERE
        COALESCE(fm.matrix_lattice_a, 2.0 * sqrt(2.0) * e.atomic_radius / 100.0) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    matrix_element,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    precipitate_lattice_a,
    matrix_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    youngs_modulus,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    shear_modulus_vrh,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    is_stable,
    precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM scored
WHERE
    lattice_mismatch_percent <= 10.0
    AND COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0.20) <= 0.20
ORDER BY
    precipitation_strengthening_score DESC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 0.20) ASC,
    youngs_modulus DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

question: Co基超合金のγ'相候補として、Co含有で安定なL1₂化合物をNi3Alとの比較で評価して。
L1₂型化合物データベースから、バルクモジュラスとせん断弾性率の比(B/G比)を計算して延性候補を抽出して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) AS bg_ratio,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', '') = 'L12'
        OR REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', '') LIKE '%L12%'
    )
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    AND et.shear_modulus_vrh > 0
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh / NULLIF(et.shear_modulus_vrh, 0) >= 1.75
    AND et.is_stable IS TRUE
ORDER BY
    bg_ratio DESC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物の安定性マップ（formation energy vs energy above hull）を出力して、候補を4象限に分類して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
            THEN 'Q1: favorable formation / on-or-near hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom > 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
            THEN 'Q2: unfavorable formation / on-or-near hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05
            THEN 'Q3: favorable formation / above hull'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom > 0
             AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05
            THEN 'Q4: unfavorable formation / above hull'
        ELSE 'unclassified'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
ORDER BY
    stability_quadrant,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: 元素周期の観点から、3d遷移金属と4d/5d遷移金属をAサイトに持つL1₂化合物の安定性傾向を比較して。
sql:
WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id
  FROM material_entry me
  LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
    ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE
    (
      COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1-2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1 2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1-2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1 2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu_3Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu%3%Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu3%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu_3%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%AuCu%3%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.phase, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.phase, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.phase, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.composition_type, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.composition_type, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(mas.composition_type, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR (
        s.space_group_number = 221
        AND me.number_of_elements = 2
        AND (
          COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%A3B%'
          OR COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE '%AB3%'
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM composition c0
            WHERE c0.entry_id = me.entry_id
              AND (
                c0.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
                OR c0.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 70 AND 80
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
),
composition_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.element,
    c.site_label,
    CASE
      WHEN c.atomic_fraction > 1 THEN c.atomic_fraction / 100.0
      ELSE c.atomic_fraction
    END AS atomic_fraction_norm,
    BOOL_OR(
      c.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
      OR c.site_label ILIKE '%A-site%'
      OR c.site_label ILIKE '%A site%'
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS has_explicit_a_site,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN c.atomic_fraction > 1 THEN c.atomic_fraction / 100.0
        ELSE c.atomic_fraction
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.entry_id) AS max_atomic_fraction_norm
  FROM composition c
  JOIN l12_entries le
    ON le.entry_id = c.entry_id
  WHERE c.element IS NOT NULL
),
a_site_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cn.entry_id,
    cn.element
  FROM composition_normalized cn
  WHERE
    (
      cn.site_label ILIKE 'A%'
      OR cn.site_label ILIKE '%A-site%'
      OR cn.site_label ILIKE '%A site%'
      OR (
        NOT cn.has_explicit_a_site
        AND cn.atomic_fraction_norm = cn.max_atomic_fraction_norm
        AND cn.atomic_fraction_norm >= 0.50
      )
    )
),
ps_by_entry AS (
  SELECT
    ps.entry_id,
    BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ps.is_stable, FALSE)) AS is_stable,
    AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
  FROM phase_stability ps
  GROUP BY ps.entry_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
    WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
  END AS a_site_period_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS num_l12_compounds,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable) AS num_stable_compounds,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable)::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id), 0),
    4
  ) AS stable_fraction,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull) AS median_energy_above_hull,
  MIN(ps.energy_above_hull) AS min_energy_above_hull,
  MAX(ps.energy_above_hull) AS max_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry me
JOIN l12_entries le
  ON le.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN a_site_candidates ac
  ON ac.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN element e
  ON e.symbol = ac.element
LEFT JOIN ps_by_entry ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(e.block, '')) = 'd'
    OR COALESCE(e.category, '') ILIKE '%transition%'
  )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
    WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
  END
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
sql:
WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
            OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        )
        AND (
            LOWER(REPLACE(s.prototype, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
            OR LOWER(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
        )
        AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    n.ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom,
    n.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al n
WHERE
    (
        LOWER(REPLACE(s.prototype, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
        OR LOWER(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '_', '')) IN ('l12', 'l1₂')
    )
    AND NOT (
        me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < n.ni3al_formation_energy_per_atom
    AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh > n.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

question: Co-Al-W系L1₂候補の安定性と弾性特性を評価して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.volume_per_atom,
    (
        SELECT string_agg(cmp.element || ':' || cmp.atomic_fraction::text, ', ' ORDER BY cmp.element)
        FROM composition AS cmp
        WHERE cmp.entry_id = me.entry_id
    ) AS composition,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable AS phase_stable,
    pde.is_on_hull,
    pde.hull_distance,
    pde.decomposition_products,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable AS elastic_stable,
    calc.method,
    calc.functional,
    calc.calculation_type
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry AS pde
    ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN calculation AS calc
    ON calc.calculation_id = et.calculation_id
WHERE
    me.number_of_elements = 3
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM composition AS c
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id AND c.element = 'Co'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM composition AS c
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id AND c.element = 'Al'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM composition AS c
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id AND c.element = 'W'
    )
    AND (
        REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2') ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    )
ORDER BY
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

question: 全L1₂化合物について、安定性スコア×格子整合性スコア×弾性スコアの複合スコアを計算してランキングして。
sql:
WITH l12 AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.lattice_b,
        s.lattice_c,
        ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable AS phase_is_stable,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio,
        et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
            OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
        )
        AND ps.is_stable IS TRUE
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        EXP(-GREATEST(COALESCE(energy_above_hull, 1.0), 0.0) / 0.050) AS stability_score,
        EXP(
            -(
                ABS(lattice_a - lattice_b) / NULLIF((lattice_a + lattice_b) / 2.0, 0.0)
              + ABS(lattice_b - lattice_c) / NULLIF((lattice_b + lattice_c) / 2.0, 0.0)
              + ABS(lattice_c - lattice_a) / NULLIF((lattice_c + lattice_a) / 2.0, 0.0)
            ) / 3.0 / 0.010
        ) AS lattice_matching_score,
        CASE
            WHEN elastic_is_stable IS FALSE THEN 0.0
            ELSE
                LEAST(
                    1.0,
                    GREATEST(COALESCE(bulk_modulus_vrh, 0.0), 0.0) / 200.0
                )
                *
                LEAST(
                    1.0,
                    GREATEST(COALESCE(shear_modulus_vrh, 0.0), 0.0) / 100.0
                )
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM l12
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    crystal_system,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_b,
    lattice_c,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull,
    phase_is_stable,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    shear_modulus_vrh,
    youngs_modulus,
    poisson_ratio,
    elastic_is_stable,
    stability_score,
    lattice_matching_score,
    elastic_score,
    stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST, entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

question: Ni3Al代替γ'相候補をバルクモジュラス、形成エネルギー、格子ミスマッチの3軸パレート面で出力して。
sql:
WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1_2%'
         OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L12%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Ni3Al%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
         OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
            AND s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
            )
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
            AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.74 AND 0.76
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Al'
            AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.24 AND 0.26
      )
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
        MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        MIN(ABS(s.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / NULLIF(r.ni3al_lattice_a, 0) * 100.0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        BOOL_OR(ps.is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
    WHERE r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L1_2%'
         OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE 'L12%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
         OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Ni3Al%'
         OR (
                s.space_group_number = 221
            AND s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'AB3')
            )
      )
      AND NOT (
          EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM composition c
              WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
                AND c.element = 'Ni'
                AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.74 AND 0.76
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM composition c
              WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
                AND c.element = 'Al'
                AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.24 AND 0.26
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system
)
SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.reduced_formula,
    c.chemical_system,
    c.prototype,
    c.strukturbericht,
    c.space_group_number,
    c.crystal_system,
    c.bulk_modulus_gpa,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom,
    c.lattice_mismatch_percent,
    c.is_stable
FROM candidates c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM candidates d
    WHERE d.bulk_modulus_gpa >= c.bulk_modulus_gpa
      AND d.formation_energy_per_atom <= c.formation_energy_per_atom
      AND d.lattice_mismatch_percent <= c.lattice_mismatch_percent
      AND (
             d.bulk_modulus_gpa > c.bulk_modulus_gpa
          OR d.formation_energy_per_atom < c.formation_energy_per_atom
          OR d.lattice_mismatch_percent < c.lattice_mismatch_percent
      )
)
ORDER BY
    c.lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    c.bulk_modulus_gpa DESC,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

question: L1₂型化合物データベースから材料設計仮説を導出するため、安定化合物の元素分布とその物性傾向を包括的に集計して。
次世代γ'相候補として、Ni-Al-Co-Ti四元系でL1₂構造をとりうる組成を探索して。
sql:
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    comp.composition,
    comp.ni_atomic_fraction,
    comp.al_atomic_fraction,
    comp.co_atomic_fraction,
    comp.ti_atomic_fraction,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.formula_type,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.volume_per_atom,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        STRING_AGG(c.element || ':' || ROUND(c.atomic_fraction::numeric, 4)::text, ', ' ORDER BY c.element) AS composition,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Ni') AS ni_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Al') AS al_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Co') AS co_atomic_fraction,
        MAX(c.atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.element = 'Ti') AS ti_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition AS c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT c.element ORDER BY c.element) = ARRAY['Al', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Ti']::text[]
) AS comp
    ON comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE me.number_of_elements = 4
  AND (
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
          UPPER(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₁₂₃_ -', '123')),
          '[^A-Z0-9]',
          '',
          'g'
      ) = 'L12'
      OR REGEXP_REPLACE(
          UPPER(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₁₂₃_ -', '123')),
          '[^A-Z0-9]',
          '',
          'g'
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
  )
ORDER BY
    ps.is_stable DESC NULLS LAST,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;
